entities.name: Operation Horseshoe
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Operation Horseshoe was a 1999 alleged plan to ethnically cleanse Kosovo Albanians and to destroy the Kosovo Liberation Army. The plan was to be carried out by Serbian police and the Yugoslav army.
